card.name: "Whopping" before a big number, and sildenafil
card.fires_on: The word "whopping" after "a" just before a large number or percentage in news or science text. It also fires on the "ildenafil" part of sildenafil in drug labels, and on "half" after "More than".

modes.label: Whopping before a figure
modes.description: The intensifier "whopping" follows "a" and introduces a surprisingly large amount.
modes.example: Canadian emissions have increased by a<< whopping>> 24 percent, in great measure

modes.label: Inside sildenafil
modes.description: The "ildenafil" part of the drug name, split after the letter S, at the start of a label sentence.
modes.example: 2.2 Use with Food S<<ildenafil>> tablets may be taken with or without food

card.plain: It fires on "whopping" before a big number, and on the middle of the drug name sildenafil.
